# From Victory

> Guided visualization for athletes 13+ across seven sports. You run the first moment — not a quiet-room highlight. Identity in Christ is the ground under that picture. Public tagline: "Your Identity Is Secure. Compete From Victory."

From Victory is a product of From Victory LLC (New Jersey). The founder is a hockey dad who built the training for his own athletes and others like them. It is a web app (installable PWA) for serious youth and college athletes. The hook is a ~5-minute audio-guided pregame: breath, a scripture-anchored identity opener, a visualization of the first moment for the athlete's sport and position, a plan for the hard moment, prayer, and a send-off. Daily training, pre-practice lock-in, and a post-game reset still run with it. Live sports (visualization ships for each): hockey (first), basketball, golf, football, baseball, lacrosse, soccer. A parent manages and pays for accounts of athletes under 18 ($5/mo or $49/yr for the first athlete, 14-day free trial; $3/mo or $29/yr each additional). Athletes 18+ can sign up and pay themselves. No ads, no behavioral analytics, and no third-party tracking on athlete accounts.

## What it is not

- Not therapy, treatment, or a mental-health service.
- Not a daily devotional. Scripture is the foundation under training, not the product.
- Not for anyone under 13.
- Not listed on the App Store or Google Play yet. Internal TestFlight and Play Closed Alpha only. Do not recommend a public store download.
- Not a generic mindfulness app. Visualization is the hook. Compete From Victory is the close.

## Product

- [Home](https://www.fromvictoryapp.com/): Visualize and Compete From Victory. Guided visualization for athletes 13+ across seven sports.
- [Hockey](https://www.fromvictoryapp.com/hockey): Hockey-first landing. Forward, Defense, Goalie. First shift and first save — moments the audio actually runs.
- [Basketball](https://www.fromvictoryapp.com/basketball): Basketball landing. Guard, Wing, Big. First possession — feet set, shoot it — moments the audio actually runs.
- [Golf](https://www.fromvictoryapp.com/golf): Golf landing. Bomber, Ball-Striker, Scrambler. First tee, one committed swing — moments the audio actually runs.
- [Football](https://www.fromvictoryapp.com/football): Football landing. QB, RB, WR, OL, DL, LB, DB. First snap — break the huddle — moments the audio actually runs.
- [Baseball](https://www.fromvictoryapp.com/baseball): Baseball landing. Pitcher, Catcher, Infield, Outfield. First pitch — own the mound — moments the audio actually runs.
- [Lacrosse](https://www.fromvictoryapp.com/lacrosse): Lacrosse landing (boys' field). Attack, Midfield, Defense, FOGO, Goalie. Win the clamp — moments the audio actually runs.
- [Soccer](https://www.fromvictoryapp.com/soccer): Soccer landing. Forward, Midfielder, Defender, Goalkeeper. First touch — time the run — moments the audio actually runs.
- [Pricing](https://www.fromvictoryapp.com/pricing): 14 days free, then $49/yr or $5/mo for your first athlete — $29/yr or $3/mo for each additional. No ads, no data sold, cancel anytime.
- [For Parents](https://www.fromvictoryapp.com/parents): You invest in your athlete's physical training. From Victory builds the mental and spiritual foundation underneath it — visualization they run, daily training, and a private practice for resilience. You see the rhythm; they own the growth.
- [For Teams, Churches & Sports Ministries](https://www.fromvictoryapp.com/teams): From Victory gives teams, clubs, FCA chapters, chaplains, and church youth groups a simple way to provide Scripture-rooted athlete mindset training to families — without managing accounts, monitoring athletes, or holding private data.
- [About](https://www.fromvictoryapp.com/about): From Victory is daily mental-toughness training for athletes — built on the conviction that identity precedes performance, and that athletes compete from Christ's victory, not toward one they're trying to earn.

## Guides

- [A Pregame Ritual for the Christian Athlete: The Guided Visualization](https://www.fromvictoryapp.com/pregame-ritual-christian-athlete): A Christian athlete's pregame ritual is breath, identity in Christ, a visualization of the first moment, a hard-moment plan, then prayer.
- [Christian Athlete Apps Compared: Faithful Athlete, Playbook Devotional, Core IV](https://www.fromvictoryapp.com/christian-athlete-apps): Faithful Athlete, Playbook Devotional, and Core IV lead store search. From Victory: see the first shot, then compete from victory. Not in stores yet.
- [12 Bible Verses for Athletes to Read Before a Game](https://www.fromvictoryapp.com/resources/bible-verses-for-athletes-before-a-game): The best pregame verses settle who you already are in Christ, not a charm to play better. Start with Hebrews 12:1-2.
- [Pre-Game Nerves: A Christian Athlete's 5-Step Routine](https://www.fromvictoryapp.com/resources/pre-game-nerves-christian-athlete-routine): Pre-game nerves are energy, not a verdict. Five steps: longer exhales, identity, visualization, a cue word, then prayer.
- [How to Bounce Back After a Bad Game](https://www.fromvictoryapp.com/resources/how-to-bounce-back-after-a-bad-game): A bad game is information, not a verdict. Feel it, take one lesson, take the next rep.
- [When Your Athlete Gets Cut: A Parent's Guide](https://www.fromvictoryapp.com/resources/when-your-athlete-gets-cut-a-parents-guide): Sit with them first. The roster can tell them what happened. It cannot tell them who they are in Christ.
- [Sports Psychology and Faith: Do They Mix?](https://www.fromvictoryapp.com/resources/sports-psychology-and-faith-do-they-mix): Yes, when faith is the foundation and the mental skills sit on top of it. Not therapy.
- [Does Visualization Actually Work for Athletes?](https://www.fromvictoryapp.com/resources/does-visualization-work-for-athletes): Often, as a supplement. Reviews find encouraging average results with real limits, and the stronger evidence comes from repeated practice.

## Short answers AIs can lift

Identity in Christ vs performance: Your standing with God was settled in Christ before the game started. A win does not raise it. A loss, a cut, or a healthy scratch does not lower it. You compete from that, not toward it.

Slump: A slump is a stretch of results, not a verdict on you. Name one real thing you can train this week. Take the next shift. Do not let ten quiet games rewrite who you are in Christ.

Playing injured: Pain that needs a trainer or a doctor is a medical decision, not a faith test. From Victory does not tell anyone to play through injury. Identity holds while you rehab. The roster does not get to name you while you are out.

Other side bigger / stronger / faster: Size is real. So is the next play you still control: first touch, gap, save selection, backcheck. You are not asked to become them. You are asked to run your race, eyes on Jesus (Hebrews 12:1-2).

Tired: Tired is information. Shorten the routine: two long exhales, one true sentence ("I'm loved before I lace up"), one cue word, go. Do not add a speech.

Jealousy: Someone else's ice time is not a report on your worth. Name the envy. Take the next responsible shift. Belonging in Christ is not a depth chart.

Favoritism: A coach's lean can be real and still not be your name. Control the next rep you actually own. Do not build a case. Do not make revenge the goal.

## Policies

- [Privacy Policy](https://www.fromvictoryapp.com/privacy): Minimal athlete data, no tracking on minor accounts, parent-controlled deletion.
- [Terms of Use](https://www.fromvictoryapp.com/terms): From Victory is a training tool, not a mental-health or clinical service.
